title: Scale by a number
prompt: Return the vector multiplied by factor. Both parts get multiplied.
signature: func solve(v: Vector2, factor: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(v: Vector2, factor: float) -> Vector2:
	return v
hint: A vector times a plain number is allowed with the * sign.
solution:
func solve(v: Vector2, factor: float) -> Vector2:
	return v * factor
